post_run_review.source: independent audit reported by the takeover thread
findings: Queue accounting and benchmark contamination: seed 1257 reportedly reduces the maker order by 33 units while crediting only 13 units.
Action-dependent RNG consumption means identical episode seeds do not establish action-independent exogenous tapes.
post_run_review.interpretation: Historical execution evidence only; the reported comparisons and confidence intervals must not be used as valid fairness or superiority proof.
post_run_review.required_follow_up: The takeover thread must correct and verify the environment, then perform a full fresh retraining and evaluation.

limitations: This is a synthetic OrderBookEnv study, not a real NASDAQ ITCH execution result.
PPO trains only on highvol; the other five regimes are simulated hold-outs.
The best baseline is selected separately per regime from these same evaluation families; the paired CI does not adjust for that winner selection.
These results do not revive the retired +50.4% exploratory claim or establish real-tape superiority.
